domain.name: Priority use-case fit

domain.name: Domain applications and reusable patterns

domain.name: Real-time and event requirement fit

domain.name: Analytics simulation and optimization fit

domain.name: Extension beyond initial use case

products.name: Palantir Foundry
products.role: Integrated operational ontology, governed data operations, applications and actions
products.fit: Cross-enterprise operational ontology and governed decision/action workflows
products.boundary: Scale and economics must be validated against workload and contract; formal RDF/OWL is not its primary model Validate contracted license/services cost, staffing model, workload economics and exit cost; integrated capability does not by itself establish lowest TCO.

products.name: Helix Foundry + HelixDB
products.role: Emerging ontology layer over graph/vector database
products.fit: Graph/vector-centric application retrieval and ontology-backed AI development
products.boundary: Public evidence is insufficient for distributed scale, HA/DR, fine-grained controls, compliance scope and enterprise operating model

products.name: Microsoft Fabric + Purview + Power Platform
products.role: Composable Microsoft data, governance, BI, application, automation and AI portfolio
products.fit: Microsoft-centered enterprise data and workflow estate
products.boundary: Ontology/action behavior spans products; confirm current availability, cross-service lineage, policy propagation and licensing Quantify cross-service implementation, identity/policy/lineage integration, capacity licensing, operational ownership and change regression.

products.name: AWS portfolio
products.role: Composable cloud data, graph, governance, workflow and AI services
products.fit: AWS-centered architectures requiring infrastructure and service breadth
products.boundary: Operational ontology is assembled rather than delivered as one object/action layer

products.name: Google Cloud portfolio
products.role: Composable cloud data, graph, governance and AI services
products.fit: Google Cloud-centered analytical and AI estates
products.boundary: Operational ontology is assembled; product lifecycle and regional availability require confirmation

products.name: Databricks
products.role: Lakehouse data engineering, governance, ML and AI platform
products.fit: Data/AI estates centered on lakehouse processing and model lifecycle
products.boundary: Unity Catalog is not by itself a graph ontology or governed operational-action layer

products.name: Snowflake
products.role: Cloud data platform with governance, semantic and AI services
products.fit: Warehouse-centric enterprise data and AI estates
products.boundary: Deep graph traversal and operational ontology actions generally require additional components

products.name: Salesforce Data Cloud + Agentforce
products.role: Customer-data, CRM object, workflow and agent platform
products.fit: Sales, service, marketing and customer operations centered on Salesforce
products.boundary: Generalization outside Salesforce-centered domains requires integration and application assessment

products.name: Stardog
products.role: RDF/OWL semantic and virtual knowledge graph
products.fit: Formal semantics, federation and ontology reuse
products.boundary: Operational applications, approvals and action workflows require additional components

products.name: Ontotext GraphDB
products.role: RDF/OWL knowledge graph and reasoning platform
products.fit: Taxonomies, linked data, semantic search and standards-based inference
products.boundary: Operational action/application layer requires additional components

products.name: TypeDB
products.role: Typed relational/logic database
products.fit: Complex typed relationships and rules
products.boundary: Enterprise platform, workflow and application breadth is narrower

products.name: Neo4j
products.role: Property-graph database and analytics platform
products.fit: Graph applications, traversal, analytics and GraphRAG
products.boundary: Palantir-style object/action/application operating layer requires assembly

products.name: RelationalAI + Snowflake
products.role: Declarative knowledge graph and logic close to Snowflake data
products.fit: Rules, optimization and decision applications in Snowflake-centered estates
products.boundary: Deployment dependency and operational action/application breadth require validation

products.name: Azure Digital Twins / Fabric digital twins
products.role: Industrial asset/twin graph and event context
products.fit: IoT, facilities, manufacturing and asset operations
products.boundary: Not a general-purpose cross-enterprise operational ontology by itself

products.name: Lance / LanceDB
products.category: AI data format and vector/multimodal database
products.role: Multimodal/vector data format and retrieval database
products.fit: AI datasets, vector retrieval and multimodal pipelines
products.boundary: Not an operational ontology, workflow or enterprise action platform

products.name: Milvus
products.role: Distributed vector database
products.fit: Large-scale ANN and vector-serving workloads
products.boundary: Requires separate ontology, action, governance and application layers

products.name: Qdrant
products.role: Vector database
products.fit: Filtered vector search and application retrieval
products.boundary: Requires separate ontology, action, governance and application layers

products.name: Weaviate
products.role: Vector database with hybrid retrieval and schema
products.fit: Vector/hybrid retrieval and AI application context
products.boundary: Requires separate enterprise action and operating layers

products.name: Vespa
products.role: Distributed search, retrieval, ranking and tensor serving
products.fit: Large-scale hybrid retrieval and ranking
products.boundary: Not an operational ontology or workflow platform

products.name: ClickHouse
products.role: Distributed analytical database
products.fit: High-throughput analytical and event workloads
products.boundary: Graph ontology and governed actions are not primary abstractions

products.name: DuckDB / MotherDuck
products.role: Embedded/cloud analytical SQL engine
products.fit: Local and cloud analytical workloads
products.boundary: Not a full enterprise operational ontology platform

products.name: Kuzu
products.role: Embedded property-graph database
products.fit: Embedded graph applications and local traversal
products.boundary: Distributed enterprise controls and operational-platform breadth require separate components

products.name: PuppyGraph
products.role: Graph query layer over external analytical/lakehouse data
products.fit: Graph analysis without maintaining a separate graph system of record
products.boundary: Operational actions, ontology governance and enterprise application layer require assembly

products.name: Spark
products.role: Distributed batch/stream processing engine
products.fit: ETL, feature engineering and large distributed computation
products.boundary: Not an operational ontology product

products.name: Flink
products.role: Distributed stateful stream-processing engine
products.fit: Event-time and continuous stateful processing
products.boundary: Not an operational ontology product

products.name: Ray
products.role: Distributed AI/compute runtime
products.fit: Parallel AI workloads, actors, training and serving orchestration
products.boundary: Not a database, ontology or complete enterprise governance layer

products.name: Daft
products.role: Distributed multimodal dataframe engine
products.fit: AI and multimodal data preparation
products.boundary: Not an operational serving, ontology or action platform

products.name: DataFusion / Ballista
products.role: Arrow-native query engine and distributed execution project
products.fit: Composable analytical execution
products.boundary: Enterprise maturity and full platform controls require validation
